Legal · Terms

Terms of Service

These terms explain how BloxStar works, what we deliver and what we expect from you. By placing an order you agree to them.

Last updated: 7 August 2026

1. About us2. Eligibility3. Orders & pricing 4. Delivery5. Payments6. Refunds 7. Fair use8. Accounts9. Liability10. Contact

1Who we are

BloxStar is an independent marketplace for in-game Roblox items across Murder Mystery 2, Adopt Me and Grow a Garden. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Roblox Corporation or any game developer. All game names and item names belong to their respective owners.

2Who can order

  • You must be at least 13 years old to use BloxStar.
  • If you are under 18, you need permission from a parent or guardian before paying.
  • You confirm the Roblox username you give us is yours or that you are allowed to receive items on it.

3Orders and pricing

Prices follow the live in-game market and can change at any time. The price shown at checkout is the price you pay for that order.

Every completed order gets a 6-digit order code. Keep it safe — it is how you claim your items and how support identifies your purchase.

We may cancel and fully refund an order if an item goes out of stock, a price was clearly listed in error, or we suspect fraud.

4Delivery

  • Delivery is done in-game by a verified trader, usually within minutes.
  • You must join the trade with the Roblox account you gave us and have trading enabled.
  • Delivery can be delayed by Roblox trade limits, new-account restrictions or server downtime — these are outside our control.
  • If nobody reaches you within 24 hours, open live chat or the support page with your order code.

5Payments

We accept card payments and crypto, plus the additional methods listed on the payment page. Crypto payments are confirmed on-chain; always keep your transaction hash until the order is delivered.

Never send money outside the checkout flow or to someone claiming to be staff in DMs. We will never ask for your Roblox password or 2-step codes.

6Refunds and cancellations

  • Not delivered? Full refund, or a replacement item if you prefer.
  • Wrong item delivered? We fix it or refund the difference.
  • Already delivered and correct? Digital items cannot be returned, so these orders are final.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method. Crypto refunds are sent to the wallet you paid from.

Refund requests should be made within 14 days of the order date.

7Fair use

You agree not to use BloxStar to launder items, resell duped or stolen goods, chargeback after delivery, abuse coupons, spam support, or attack the site. Breaking these rules means we can cancel open orders and block future purchases.

8Your account

You are responsible for keeping your BloxStar login details private and for everything done from your account. Tell us straight away if you think someone else has access.

9Liability

BloxStar is provided as-is. To the extent the law allows, our total responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for that order. We are not responsible for losses caused by Roblox bans, game updates, item value changes or actions taken by you in-game.

10Changes and contact

We may update these terms; the version shown here always applies to new orders. Questions?

Discord: foggmagic · karimhaleem
Email: business@bloxistar.com

BloxStar is not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.

Legal · Privacy

Privacy Policy

Short version: we only collect what we need to deliver your order, we never sell your data, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.

Last updated: 7 August 2026

1. What we collect2. Why3. Payments 4. Sharing5. Storage6. Retention 7. Your rights8. Children9. Contact

1What we collect

  • Order info: Roblox username, items ordered, order code, order status.
  • Contact info: email address, and your Discord handle if you give it.
  • Account info: display name, avatar choice and a hashed password if you sign up.
  • Payment info: the method used, amount, and a crypto transaction hash where relevant.
  • Support messages: what you send us in live chat or the support form.
  • Basic technical data: device/browser type and approximate region, used for security.

2Why we use it

  • To deliver your items to the right Roblox account.
  • To let you claim an order and check its status.
  • To answer support requests and handle refunds.
  • To detect fraud, chargeback abuse and duped items.

We do not use your data for advertising profiles and we do not sell it to anyone.

3Payment data

Card details are entered for payment processing and are never stored on BloxStar servers in full — we keep only what is needed to identify a transaction (such as the last digits and the amount). Crypto payments are public on their blockchain by design; we only store the transaction hash you give us.

We never store your Roblox password, and we never need it.

4Who we share with

  • Verified traders — only your Roblox username and the items to deliver.
  • Payment and hosting providers — to process payments and run the site.
  • Authorities — only when legally required.

5Storage and security

Data is stored with our hosting and database provider over encrypted connections. Passwords are stored hashed, access is limited to the owner and admins, and some preferences (like your cart) are kept locally in your own browser.

6How long we keep it

  • Order records: up to 24 months, for refunds and dispute handling.
  • Support chats: up to 12 months.
  • Account data: until you ask us to delete your account.

7Your rights

You can ask us to show you the data we hold, correct it, delete it, or stop using it. Email us and we will reply within 30 days. Deleting order data may make refunds impossible to verify afterwards.

8Children

BloxStar is not intended for children under 13. If we learn an account belongs to a child under 13, we delete it and its data.

9Contact

Email: business@bloxistar.com
